evaluation: Historical real-bug replay with independently authored tests. Not held out; may be represented in model training data.
issue: On Windows, safe_join currently accepts special device filenames such as CON and NUL. It should return None for Windows special device names, while preserving ordinary joins and traversal rejection. Do not open any Windows device; this is string validation only. Tests execute on Linux: emulate the Windows branch by replacing the target module-local os reference (werkzeug.security.os) with a SimpleNamespace(name="nt", path=posixpath), without changing the global os module. Without Windows emulation, CON remains an ordinary Linux filename and must still be accepted.
